queue.title: Proposal-margin value-of-computation gate
queue.hypothesis: Deeper lookahead is useful primarily when the best and second-best one-step experiment proposals have similar predicted value. A local proposal-margin gate can retain most of any causal-recovery benefit while invoking two-step search far less often than always-two.
queue.design: At each experiment-selection step, compute the normal one-step proposal scores. Define normalized margin = (best - second_best) / max(abs(best), epsilon). Invoke two-step lookahead only when margin < tau; otherwise execute the one-step winner. Tune tau on training worlds, freeze it, then prospectively compare margin-gated, always-one, and always-two under equal experiment budget with compute accounting and RNG isolation.
queue.primary_metric: Pareto performance over edge error and compute time

queue.title: Unconditional three-step or MCTS epistemic search
queue.reason: Unconditional depth failed at ~9x compute; only selective search is justified.

queue.title: Parallel designer proposals plus selective tree search
queue.hypothesis: Epistemically diverse proposal generation improves selective search quality when deeper search is invoked only under local ambiguity.

queue.title: Reward and credit assignment ablation
queue.hypothesis: Counterfactual or trajectory-aware credit can improve policy learning once downstream value estimates are available.

queue.title: Model misspecification transfer
queue.hypothesis: A controller that succeeds only when its Bayesian world class is correct will degrade under nonlinear, confounded, imperfect-intervention, or nonstationary worlds; model-uncertainty mechanisms should reduce that degradation.

dynamic_enqueue_rules: Every completed experiment must generate at least one next candidate unless a stronger queued candidate already tests the same uncertainty.
Falsification never empties the queue; it narrows or redirects it.
Do not enqueue equivalent retries without a changed causal hypothesis, state representation, reward, search depth, world model, or evaluation design.
Promote surprising anomalies and control victories into diagnostic experiments.
Maintain matched resource budgets and preserve all negative results.
